meta_description:
82K likes, 492 comments - kaybykatrina on October 9, 2026: "Such a special moment for all of us at Kay Beauty to see a brand born in India find its place at an iconic British beauty destination like @spacenk What started as a passion to create a brand that speaks the beauty language of the South Asian community has become a journey that continues to surprise and inspire us❤️🙏🏻

It makes me so happy to see South Asian brands and voices finding their place on the global beauty stage🙏🏻

Thank you to everyone who came out to celebrate with us, braved the London rain and showed us so much love. Your support makes this journey even more special🫶🏻🫶🏻

Here’s to celebrating beauty in all its forms, speaking your own beauty language, and always remembering #ItsKayToBeYou 🫶🏻🇬🇧

📸: @amanfilmographer 

#KayBeauty #KayBeautyUK #Nykaa".
